author: imaxel
description:

Interact button to enter, G to exit
W & S for throttle
A & D for yaw
Mouse for pitch & roll

L1 & R1 for yaw
Left stick for pitch & roll

Plane position will be saved and shared globally between savegames
You can spawn a new one at any time

author: ohmyjeeves
description:
Mod Hot Reloader User Guide


The Mod Hot Reloader allows developers to hot reload mods without restarting the game. Follow this guide to configure and use the tool.


Prerequisites


  • Mod Not Installed: Add a Directory.Build.props file to prevent automatic installation.
  • Backend Code Only: The tool does not support UI components, allowing you to rebuild and debug backend code without reloading the game.
  • Correct Settings: Configure settings, then use InvokeMethodWithinHotLoadedMod to trigger code within your mod. Check Unity Explorer Log for troubleshooting.

How To Use ModHotReloader

  1. Create a new mod project via Red Mod Manager.
  2. Add the Directory.Build.props file to your project:
    <Project><PropertyGroup><DisableCopyToGame>True</DisableCopyToGame></PropertyGroup></Project>

  3. Configure the settings to point to the new mod, ensuring the DLL name and path are correct.

  4. Load up the game.

  5. Verify the mod is loaded via Unity Explorer Log.

  6. Add a method to your mod that prints to the log:
    private void HelloWorld() { RLog.Msg("Hello From Your Mod!"); }

  7. Rebuild the mod project while the game is running. The hot reloader will detect changes and reload the mod.

  8. Check Unity Explorer Log to confirm the mod was reloaded.

  9. Add a breakpoint to the method. Attach your debugger using Unity Explorer.

  10. Invoke the method using InvokeMethodWithinHotLoadedMod HelloWorld and check the log for your message.

author: ohmyjeeves
description:
True Survival by OhMyJeeves

Removed Modern Food, Drink & Medicine


  • Medicine
  • Drink Cans
  • Ramen
  • Energy Bars
  • MRE Packs
  • Cereal Boxes
  • Canned Food

Increased Inventory For Meat, Fish & Plant Mixes


  • Fish: Increased to 6 from 3
  • Meat: Increased to 10 from 7
  • Bacon, Steak & Brain Bites: Increased to 5 from 1
  • Health Mix (& +): Increased to 10 from 3
  • Energy Mix (& +): Increased to 10 from 3

Increase Flask Usages


  • Increased Flask Usage: 4 uses instead of 2 to balance removed drinks

Improved Spear For Hunting


  • Thrown Damage: Boosts damage to make it effective for hunting (e.g. one hit kills a deer)
  • Melee Damage: Increases melee damage a small amount to make it a more viable early game weapon

Rebalance Animal Traps & Hutches


  • Fish Traps: Hold 1 fish instead of 5 and slower spawn rate as default is OP
  • Small Rabbit Hutch: Hold 3 rabbits instead of 2 to allow for breeding (10% each sleep)
  • Rabbit Hutch: Increase breed rate to increase viability (50% each sleep)

Rebalance Drops From Animals

  • Squirrels: Drop brain bites to reduce effectiveness of small animal trap and ease of getting meat
  • Raccoons: Drop 1 meat instead of 2 to balance small game hunting
  • Turtles: Drop 2 meat instead of 3 to increase viability of traps / hutches
  • Deer: Drop 2 meat instead of 3 to increase viability of traps / hutches
  • Moose: Drop 4 meat instead of 5 to increase viability of traps / hutches

Rebalance Planters

  • Reduce time for plants to grow from 2 days to 1 day
  • Fix mushrooms so they produce a positive yield on harvest

author: thirtytwelve
description:
GolfcartTeleport is an innovative mod that lets players use a golf cart to teleport to their desired locations seamlessly. The user dont need to install anything! ## How to use - Type command in chat - Get into the newly spawned "ghost" golfcart. - Leave the golfcart as normal. ## Commands: - Access via inGame Chat: -
**user1**: /tpa user2 /tpr user2 Side note, the username does not need to be exact.
-
**user2**: /tpaccept user1 /tpyes user1 /tpy user1 Side note, the username does not need to be exact.
-
/home number "number" is required if more than 1 (Default MaxHome is 1; adjustable in config)
-
/sethome number "number" is required if more than 1 (Default MaxHome is 1; adjustable in config)
#
**Why Golfcart:** No golf cart is needed. It spawns a golf cart in front of you. Get in and out. Golfcart is for internal use, as this is a server-side mod. This was the simplest solution I found since player position can't directly be changed from the server.
<- clickable!

  • Dedicated Server
  • Multiplayer Hosts
  • (Should Not Be Any Issues if you have it anyways)
    • Made by ThirtyTwelve

author: sknthelisper
description:
I was very dissapointed by the damage guns do in this game. It's so bad you're better off using almost anything else than them, there's no reason to use a shotgun over a fireaxe, for example (beyond energy cost), as it takes 2 swings to kill most mutants, and 4+ shots to kill them with a slug...


Thereby this mod. I've boosted the damage multiplier for shotgun\pistol by x2.5, Revolver by x3.5 and rifle by x2 (it didn't need as much of a boost). You can also change these values in the settings if you want.


Shotgun:
Changed the default spread cone angle of the shotgun to 5 (vanilla is 20!) which makes the spread sligthly tigther than in real-life (somewhere between 6-7 is probably closer to reality).


With 5, at about 15 meters you'll (generally) be able to down a deer with a proper aimed shot (assuming it's standing sideways so you got a bigger target, otherwise, it'll take 3-4 shots to down it), at 10 meters it's pretty consistent to take it down (even if it's staring at you).


To compensate for the (massive) increase in accuracy of the buckshot (i.e; much lower spread), the buckshot deals less damage (configurable between 0.01 to 1, where 1 means all 8 pellets will deal the same damage as 1 slug).

author: sknthelisper
description:
Increased the light intensity (effectively the brightness) of the flashlight(s) to make them a bit more useful\realistic.


Very minor issue: With the flashlight attachment (for weapons) I can only access the light after it's been initialized, which requires re-equpping the weapon to get the changed lightsource. Mod already does this for you automatically this first time (that it's required), which means you'll hear an "unequipt\equipt" sound play (you're instantaniously equipping\unequipping the weapon).


Sligthly annoying, but better than having an actually useless flashlight.

author: thirtytwelve
description: # OptionalDependAPI > *"Screw dependencies, shoot a laser on them, make them optional!"* ## Overview OptionalDependAPI is a lightweight library, allowing seamless integration with other mods without requiring hard dependencies. This solves the common problem where your mod could benefit from additional features provided by other mods, but you don't want to force users to install those other mods if they don't want or need those extra features. ## The Problem Ever had a mod that would be great on its own but could have more features if it integrated with other mods? Without a proper solution: - You either force users to install mods they might not want (hard dependencies) - Or you miss out on potential integration features altogether ## My Solution OptionalDependAPI provides a clean, standardized way to handle optional mod dependencies: 1. **Register** your mod's API with OptionalDependAPI 2. **Subscribe** to other mods you want to integrate with 3. **Check** if those mods are available at runtime 4. **Use** their features only when available No hard dependencies on other mods, no compatibility patches, just simple runtime checks and graceful feature enabling. ### Limitation One important caveat: mods that want to use this system will need to include OptionalDependAPI as a dependency. ## Changelog - **v1.0.0**: Initial release ### [OptionalDependAPI Github](https://github.com/ThirtyTwelveNor/SOTFOptionalDependAPI)

author: clairenheit1367

Settings are applied in certain specific circumstances, so expect to reload/rejoin to fully notice changes. It even works with the game's outfits! (Helmet mileage may vary, expect it to clip with armor if unhidden) Full options list: - Tactical vest - Helmet (dead corpse “hemlet” model by default) - FAST/Cutscene helmet model swap (requires helmet to be enabled) - Name tags for other players (displays Steam usernames, works best if you disable visible world icons in SOTF’s settings) - Hide backpacks (for a cleaner look) - Gloves (for first-person and co-op players) - "Old jacket" option, like Kelvin and cutscene guys wear. This is the only clothing piece that was designed for the gloves. - Balaclavas and/or sunglasses (to look like the intro pilot) - Hide equipped armor pieces (such as creepy or bone armor) - Option to give Kelvin his helmet back The binoculars break the first-person gloves, but changing outfits fixes them. Your PlayerLocation patch method worked, thank you GLaD0S, I love you <3 https://github.com/clairenheit/ArmorMod

author: razorwings18
description:
Description Disables the GPS tracker either immediately or after a random amount of time. Once disabled, it can optionally turn into a compass. The maximum potential time that it will work, and whether it will turn into a compass are configurable options. Highly Recommended Complementary Mods This mod is meant to be combined with my other mod: Writable Paper Map Installation instructions - Install RedLoader if you haven't already. - Unzip to your game's main folder (where SonsOfTheForest.exe is located) maintaining the ZIP's folder structure. (The .DLL will end up under the Mods folder, and the .json under the Mods/RW18_GPSdown folder.)


Main features
  • Disables the GPS tracker, either immediately or after a random amount of time.
  • Once disabled, it can turn into a compass or show a "NO SIGNAL" message depending on your settings.
  • The maximum potential time that it will work is configurable. It will randomly stop working at some point before your set limit.
  • Even in "NO SIGNAL" mode the tracker is not completely useless - it still emits beeps for nearby GPS tags. You can actually get lost in the forest. Waking up in a random village without knowing where you are hits different now! Requirements Must have RedLoader installed.

author: razorwings18

author: razorwings18
description:
WARNING Only works with keyboard & mouse Description In-game paper map you can write on. Marks already-explored areas as you walk. Optionally hides your position. Toolbar to select different modes. Protractors help you triangulate your position. Has a few configurable options. Highly Recommended Complementary Mods I highly recommend you combine this mod with these other mods I made to bring back the original "The Forest" experience: GPS Tracker Disabled or Compass Remove KnightVs and Golf Carts Installation instructions - Install RedLoader if you haven't already. - Unzip to your game's main folder (where SonsOfTheForest.exe is located) maintaining the ZIP's folder structure. (The .DLL will end up under the Mods folder, and the .json under the Mods/RW18_PaperMap folder.)

Use
  • Bring it up by pressing the "N" key.
  • Zoom: Zoom in/out using the mouse wheel or the middle mouse button.
  • Pan: Right-click and drag to pan the map.
  • Toolbar at the top: Select between pan, write, erase, protractor 1 and protractor 2 modes. Instructions for each mode are shown on the bottom-left.

    Configurable Options
  • Enable player marker (WARNING!!!: To re-enable the marker, you'll be asked to click on your current position on the map. This is so that you're not tempted to re-enable it to peek your current position if you're lost)
  • Reveal radius: How much is "revealed" as you walk.
  • Must click current position to reveal map: Click on your position on the map to mark areas recently explored. This is so that if you're lost, you can't use recently-revealed areas to hint at your position.
  • Reveal terrain while flying: Mark overflown areas as explored in the map.

author: razorwings18
description:
Description Radial Menu for quick access to items and consumables. Press ALT to bring up, navigate with the mouse and click to equip or consume items. Installation instructions - Install RedLoader if you haven't already. - Unzip to your game's main folder (where SonsOfTheForest.exe is located) maintaining the ZIP's folder structure. (The .DLL will end up under the Mods folder, and the .json under the Mods/RW18_RadialMenu folder.)

Main features A radial menu for quick access to your inventory items. Will equip or consume the selected items. Only items in your inventory are shown. You can still move (walk, run, strafe) while the menu is active.

Use
  • Press and hold the LEFT ALT key
  • Place the mouse over the category you want to unfold
  • Click on the item that you want to equip/consume or click on already equipped items to put them away.

    • Known Issues
  • Meat/Fish/Oyster: Will consume a random one from your inventory, so it may consume spoiled items.
  • Cooking pot: Clicking it when already equipped won't put it away.

    • Requirements Must have Red Loader installed.
